line.text: Every way to afford it you have not chosen, ranked by what the figures say it raises: HMRC’s and the Treasury’s where they exist, our own arithmetic, badged, where they do not. One that breaks a promise says so.
line.short: The ways to pay you have not chosen, ranked by what each raises.

line.text: What you chose to deliver, biggest first. Start one a year later and it costs nothing until it starts; narrow one to half the distance; or drop it. The department feels each, and the Prime Minister notices.
line.short: What you chose to deliver, biggest first: start it later, narrow it, or drop it.

line.text: Lowering the target costs nothing today; the markets never saw it. They see the number: Budget 2025 left £21.7bn, the OBR’s typical five-year error is about £32bn, and the Bank found this year’s gilt moves amplified by hedge fund deleveraging.
line.short: Lowering the target costs nothing today. The markets judge the number, not the target.

line.text: Room to spare is room to deliver: the ways to deliver your priorities you have not chosen, one for each priority first, each priced against your Budget as it stands. Each is a settlement above the Spending Review path.
line.short: The ways to deliver your priorities you have not chosen, one for each priority first.

line.text: Every way to pay you chose can come out again. The figure beside each is HMRC’s or the Treasury’s where one exists and ours, badged, where it does not; beside it is the headroom that dropping it would leave.
line.short: The ways to pay you chose, each with the headroom that dropping it would leave.

line.text: Money not spent is the cheapest insurance you can buy: the OBR’s typical five-year error is about £32bn, and Budget 2025 left £21.7bn. Keep the margin, or raise your target so the sums hold you to it.
line.short: Money not spent is the cheapest insurance: the OBR’s typical five-year error is about £32bn.

line.text: The Charter lets a Chancellor suspend the rules in a significant shock, judged by the OBR. A rule missed by choice is not that; the OBR will say so on Budget day. Nothing stops you. Write down that you know.
line.short: A rule missed by choice is not a shock; the OBR will say so. Write down that you know.

noBreach.text: No rule is missed on these numbers. Leaving the gap open is not a breach; it is less headroom than you meant to keep, and the target is yours to lower if you can live with that.
